review.notes: Full re-review (180 changed lines). All 8 findings of the previous review are repaired; ALMP Propositions 2.3/2.5 were checked against arXiv:1112.0989v1, fetched without a manifest. Six P3 findings: a false docstring remark on the open-cone topology for noncompact L (witness omega_1); a non-discriminating Check in 7.2; a chapter-level locator and missing domain in 7.1 (replaced by vdD-Miller 4.2); compactness in 7.3 where closedness suffices; six targets with no locator or 'own' mark; three time-bound sentences. Gate: every check 0 except depcheck NOT IN ORDER against the public order file (not a defect); depcheck against the candidate order with --movable gives 239 roadmaps, 2353 edges, 0 problems; no edits outside the folder. Lean: lake env lean exits 0 with 4 sorry warnings; #check of all 16 declarations matches the README; no sorryAx in definitions; the one-tactic probe fails on all 4 theorems. Seeded sample checked in lurie-ha, woolf2009, treumann2009, joyce2012, almp2012, aft2017, nocera-volpe2023, mather2012 and vdd-miller1996; vdd1998 has no legal source (not verifiable); bcr1998 and lee2013 are uncertified. Citations resolved: AlgebraicTopologyPartII 16.1a-e at 674154f, ShimuraVarieties 3.4b-e and 3.5a at #933, and RealAnalyticGeometry R2.1, AffineMorseLefschetz A4.1, GeometricTopology L1, DifferentialGeometry 5.5 and AlgebraicTopology Stage 7 on main.
